info.name: Namma Blood — Phase 4.3 Emergency Blood Connection API
info.description:
Comprehensive manual test collection for Phase 4.3 of Namma Blood.

Pre-populated with verified working development credentials for instant testing:
- Regular User: priya.rajan@example.com / ghz%BM^@5hvQT*H
- Admin: admin@nammablood.org / Password_123
- Blood Bank: adyar.lifeline@example.com / Dp3u!g^pV2w5S%h
- Staff (Medical Officer): mo.adyar@nammablood.internal / 63u^HTRSjXTs2ac

All protected endpoints inherit Bearer Token authorization from the collection, powered by the `{{token}}` variable which is automatically populated upon any successful login.

pm.test("Privacy Shield enforces candidate sanitization", function () {

exec: pm.test("Operates in administrative fallback mode", function () {

item.name: 04 - Emergency Request Matching
item.description: Dual-stream matching engine for verified emergency requests (`GET /api/emergency/requests/:id/matches`), featuring strict BOLA/IDOR protection, independent pagination, and HMAC candidate referencing.

item.name: 4.1 GET Request Matches - Dual Stream Candidate Discovery [200 OK]

exec: pm.test("Matching payload structure adheres to Milestone 4.3.3.4 spec", function () {
pm.test("Dual-stream pagination containers are independent", function () {
pm.test("HMAC candidate references adhere to DNR- and BB- format", function () {

query.description: Blood bank candidate stream page size

request.description: Executes request matching on a verified active emergency request using its MongoDB ObjectId `{{requestId}}`.

item.name: 4.2 GET Request Matches - Independent Donor & Blood Bank Pagination [200 OK]

exec: pm.test("Enforces independent donor vs blood bank pagination parameters", function () {

request.description: Verifies independent pagination control where donor stream is on page 2 (limit 5) while blood bank stream is on page 1 (limit 3).

item.name: 4.3 GET Request Matches - By Human-Readable Request Number [200 OK]

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 OK or 404 if seed request not created", function () {

request.description: Verifies that the matching engine accepts formatted human-readable request numbers (`EMG-YYYYMMDD-XXXXXX`) in addition to 24-character hexadecimal MongoDB ObjectIds.

item.name: 4.4 GET Request Matches - Malformed Request Identifier [400 Bad Request]

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {
pm.test("Fails closed with INVALID_REQUEST_IDENTIFIER error code", function () {

request.description: Negative Test: An identifier that is neither a 24-character hex ObjectId nor an EMG- requestNumber fails validation with HTTP 400.

item.name: 4.5 GET Request Matches - Missing Request or Unauthorized BOLA [404 Not Found]

exec: pm.test("Status code is 404 Not Found", function () {

request.description: Negative Test: Enforces anti-enumeration security. A non-existent request and an unauthorized user request return the exact same 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND response.

item.name: 4.6 GET Request Matches - Invalid Donor Limit (>50) [400 Bad Request]

exec: pm.test("Status code is 400 Bad Request", function () {
pm.expect(jsonData.message).to.include("Donor page limit must be an integer between 1 and 50");

request.description: Negative Test: Page limit exceeding the allowed ceiling of 50 returns HTTP 400.

item.name: 4.7 GET Request Matches - Unauthenticated Access [401 Unauthorized]

request.description: Negative Test: Matching endpoint without Bearer authentication returns HTTP 401.
